tooltip.flowing_fluids.waterway_liner.1: Lines a channel bed to cut drag and speed water along its run.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.waterway_liner.2: No facing: place flat under flowing water; works as a floor.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.waterway_liner.3: Strongest in narrow, shaped channels, not broad still pools.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.waterway_liner.4: Pairs with Pressure Nozzles to build long pumped canals.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.pressure_nozzle.1: Pumps water from its back face to its front face.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.pressure_nozzle.2: Faces any of 6 directions: up lifts water against gravity, down draws it.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.pressure_nozzle.3: Conserves water: only moves what exists, never floods or drains a source dry.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.pressure_nozzle.4: Also pressurizes water touching its four side faces toward the facing direction.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.water_level_senso: Reads the water level on its front face and updates continuously.
Outputs 0-15 redstone power from the back, with full water at max signal.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.rain_collector.1: Catches open-sky rain and stores it inside the block.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.rain_collector.2: Right-click empty-handed to toggle RF absorption mode.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.rain_collector.3: When powered, it absorbs nearby rain water before it forms around it.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.rain_collector.4: Sneak-right-click empty-handed to cycle radius and RF cost.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.water_absorber.1: Drains nearby water into its internal tank.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.water_absorber.3: Sneak-right-click empty-handed to cycle scan radius.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.water_absorber.4: Consumes 250 RF per water level removed.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.ocean_refill_supp: Disables infinite-biome water refill in a local radius.
Use it beside drain machines so oceans can be emptied on purpose.
Sneak-right-click empty-handed to cycle radius and RF cost.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_dropl: Acts like a stand-in player for nearby fluid updates.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_brook: Acts like a stand-in player for nearby fluid updates.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_chann: Acts like a stand-in player for nearby fluid updates.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_wells: Acts like a stand-in player for nearby fluid updates.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_lakeh: Acts like a stand-in player for nearby fluid updates.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.flow_anchor_surve: Hold it to reveal nearby flow anchor and refill suppressor radii.
Scans loaded hydraulic range blocks around you without changing their behavior.
tooltip.flowing_fluids.fluid_debug_probe: Right-click a block to inspect its raw and effective fluid state.
Reports block id, fluid id, amount, source flag, and own height.
Debug read only. It does not change water behavior.
